sources.license: all-rights-reserved
sources.content_hash_scope: sha256_exact_response_bytes
sources.summary: MNC Sekuritas visited H1 on September 23 and reported a combined 75 MW IT load for the five operating campus facilities, citing the H1 campus review and management discussion.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: Christian Sitorus, MNC Sekuritas Research Division
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: Named research analyst and participant in the 23 September tour and management discussion at H1
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: DCI Indonesia H1 Campus, Cibitung; existing JK1, JK2, JK3, JK5 and JK6
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The report explicitly dates a September23 H1 visit, describing "touring the facilities and discussing operations and growth plans with management". Its H1 section states the campus "operates five data centers (JK1, JK2, JK3, JK5, and JK6)" and describes current customer service in JK6.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: Actual date of participant site tour and management discussion, explicitly stated in the first paragraph. September29 is publication, not observation.
firsthand_status_statement.review: Primary only for the first-hand contemporaneous H1 visit and stated existing operation. Publisher remains MNC Sekuritas and evidence kind remains analyst_report, not an operator disclosure. Financial analysis, forecasts, certification generalizations and management-reported capacity are not independently measured physical observations. One existing campus only; no new expansion project.
